notes: Authored Playfair Display weight deltas transferred onto Couture's edited outlines. Direct cyclic node matching where compatible; monotone contour correspondence where the source changed curve counts.
Original source node and handle topology remains compatible across every master. Curve correspondence is baked offline; runtime only interpolates these drawings.

Playfair keeps its math operators, slashes and daggers at fixed stroke weight; Couture also keeps the degree sign fixed, and Sonnet the bullet. These upstream choices remain in the transferred masters.

Asterisk repair in the new masters: six inner petal tips are collapsed to six separated points seven units from (242,519), removing two spurious source islands. The original outline-v1 snapshot remains unchanged.
Local width recipe Couture: a smooth horizontal ink/space field, compiled to compatible Bézier drawings. These are new TypeLab designs, not upstream width instances.
Shared exact cuts retain the neutral family; every new segment records its old segment and parameter interval in a separate master-subdivision-v1 binding. Maximum sampled fit error 0.015 font units.

Rigid glyph constructions iIl!¡|.,:;'"‘’“”„‚·•` retain their ink shape and gain centered spacing. Dots on ij?:;¿… translate without distortion. Other glyphs preserve vertical coordinates and distribute width through horizontal white space.
